requestedBy: User: double-check IsoGraph translation, implicit assertion process, and discovery protocol categorical errors
sourceBoundary: Preserve historical graph, assertions, warrants, qualifications and source hashes. Record corrections and their downstream dispositions separately.

scope.translation: Complete late decomposition native edge census against vocabulary and companion meaning; qualified hot-loop and Core020 representation distinctions
scope.implicitAssertions: All late IA identities and check generator; Core020 complete admission/fixed-point process and load-bearing inference claims
scope.discoveryProtocol: Protocol definitions versus actual application: objective/quantifier changes, symmetry quotients, evidence classes, representation-dependent obstructions
scope.integration: Distinguish false deduction, omitted guard, mismatched translation, incomplete verification, valid bounded evidence and open hypothesis; trace affected descendants

verification: Read source and native expressions; reproduce concrete logical failures using tiny algebraic countermodels where possible. Passing syntax, identity or rank checks are not treated as semantic inference proof.

continuity.freshExtension: Source checkpoint only; no preparation or scalar replay while this audit has priority
continuity.moverGauge: Existing structural-only preparation may continue; no new scalar replay before committed structural freeze

acceptance: Persist exact findings with source pins, reproducible evidence, qualifications/corrections, downstream impact and honest audit coverage; do not silently promote a new graph authority
nativeSuccessorQualification: NOT_PERFORMED: historical artifacts remain unchanged; corrected research interpretations and unresolved reconstruction obligations are recorded separately
